data.title: 📌 STAGE 1: INGESTION & ROUTING
data.text:
• Ingress: POST /havenmatch/match
• Uses location supplied by the authenticated user/property data; no hardcoded geographic defaults.
• Enforces caller identity and role authorization.

data.label: ACTION ROUTER & NORMALIZER

data.title: 📌 STAGE 2: REAL MONGODB DATABASE
data.text:
• Database: havenmatch | Collection: properties
• Queries verified active listings using Atlas Credential
• Pure database retrieval without mock arrays.

data.label: HARD CONSTRAINTS FILTER

data.title: 📌 STAGE 3: LIVE TELEMETRY & SCORING
data.text:
• Dynamic OpenStreetMap Overpass query using property coordinates
• Haversine distance formula calculation
• 100-Point multi-factor lifestyle score.

data.label: HAVERSINE & MATCH SCORING

data.title: 📌 STAGE 4: AUDIT & DELIVERY
data.text:
• Sorts Top 10 recommendations by score descending
• Persists audit record to havenmatch.match_results
• Returns clean JSON response with HTTP 200.

data.label: PACKAGE RECOMMENDATIONS
